failing_commit: 748579ad (the v0.3.1 notes merge — docs only, zero backend changes)
objective: The release gate failed with no code change since the green run. Root cause must be proven, not guessed, before any release.

the_defect.what: sync_system_update consulted the CachyOS update notice BEFORE its database precondition. The notice check is interactive and networked: it fetches iso-stats.cachyos.org live, reads the operator's real ~/.cache/calix cache, and asks a question no test can answer with 'yes'. A declined or unanswerable notice short-circuited the function to an empty success — before any database check.
the_defect.why_the_gate_flipped: Green all day while the fetch failed (catch -> proceed -> sync(true) -> SyncDbFailed). Red at 15:02 when the live notice finally served (the amdgpu/Kernel 7.3.0-2 warning, id 2130f114) and no saved answer existed.
the_defect.why_the_container_stayed_green: The Arch replay's os-release is not CachyOS, so the hook never loaded.

the_probe.method: a scratch test printed the same setup's actual outcomes
the_probe.sync_system_update_dbonly: SUCCESS (empty report) — the notice path decided, the databases were never reached

the_fix.what: the database precondition (alpm_get_syncdbs == null, the same check syncDatabases applies) is verified before the notice check
the_fix.property: a manager that cannot name a sync database must report SyncDbFailed however the notice is answered: on any machine, with or without a network
the_fix.intent_preserved: for a working installation, the notice is still asked before any database download

the_measurements.gate_after: the full verify roster green on the dirty checkout (local-verify-20261022T151353Z)

artifacts.what: the failing log lines, the probe, the live notice payload, the mechanism, the numbers
